android.desc: Audiofy media player is a free and open source multimedia player that plays most multimedia files Audiofy for Android is a full audio/video player, with a complete database, an equalizer and filters, playing all weird audio/video formats. Supported formats: -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Audio: Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, ALAC, PCM/WAVE (μ-law, A-law), MP1, MP2, MP3, AMR (NB, WB), AAC (LC, ELD, HE; xHE on Android 9+), AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD * Video: H.263, H.264 AVC (Baseline Profile; Main Profile on Android 6+), H.265 HEVC, MPEG-4 SP, VP8, VP9, AV1 * Streaming: DASH, HLS, RTSP * Subtitles: SRT, SSA, ASS, TTML, VTT This project is still in development and is expected to have bugs. Features –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––– * Audiofy for Android™ plays most local video and audio files. * Audiofy Media Player has a media library for audio and video files and allows to browse folders directly. * Audiofy Media Player support for multi-track audio and subtitles. It supports auto-rotation, aspect-ratio adjustments and gestures to control volume, brightness and seeking. * Double tap to seek. * It also includes a dynamic widget for audio control, cover art and a complete audio media library. * Material 3 (you) support * Audio/Subtitle track selection * Vertical swipe to change brightness (left) / volume (right) * Playback speed control * Manual Accent/Primary color selection. * Resize (fit/crop). * Controls lock Contact -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If you have any feedback, suggestions, or issues with Media Player, please feel free to contact us through any of the following channels: 1.
